South Carolina didn’t have a single Black American in the state house or Congress between 1892-1970. I was honored to speak with Rep. Jim Felder who won in 1970 and made history. Every American needs to listen to his story.

Zero investigations, indictments, arrests, or even so much as a parking ticket for Epstein’s coconspirators. As Melania said, Epstein did not act alone.

Just watched Chloe Zhao's brilliant Hamnet. I found compelling Shakespeare's struggle in pursuing his art with his love for his family and the tribute he pays to his son's dreams in the closing scenes of Hamlet. A movie about deep human love and how we make any sense of loss.

The only reason we do not have Medicare for All, which LBJ thought would happen, is the corruption of private health insurance money and Democrats who have been unwilling to fight for it.


Dr. Abdul El-Sayed (@AbdulElSayed)

The people of Michigan are sick and tired of politicians who tell us what we can't have and shouldn't fight for... 

We can fight for a world where everybody can be guaranteed healthcare.
